transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
I'm Vega, your supportive care assistant. I'm here to help ensure everything is going smoothly with your medication. Have you been able to take it today?
I don't understand, what were we saying?
I understand this can be confusing. We're just checking in to see if you've taken your medication today. Have you had a chance to do that yet?
I'm still here. It may be time for your medication — have you been able to take it?

Please do not be concerned. These situations can happen, and we can address it calmly. If you are uncertain whether you have taken your medication, let us pause and check first. There is no need to rush. We will resolve this carefully and safely.
